messages:
alice-support: Hey team — customer reported our autorouter invoked the `legacy_payflow` tool instead of `refund_v2` when they sent a refund request. They attached the request body and we reproduced it.
ben-eng: Can you paste the original payload? Also which customer/account id? :thinking_face:
alice-support: customer id 67244. Payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "user_id": "u-67244",
  "amount": 12.00,
  "currency": "USD",
  "note": "refund for order 891"
}
```
It should map to refund_v2. Logs show autorouter confidence favored legacy_payflow (0.61) over refund_v2 (0.59).
ciara-ml: Hmm that's a small confidence gap. Recent model tweak changed the weighting on "legacy" aliases. I can pull the scoring trace. Give me a sec.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout/autorouter-weighting v2026-02-14 started by @ciara-ml at 2026-02-14T15:02:11Z
ciara-ml: Scoring trace for request 2026-02-14T15:11:09Z:
- features: {has_amount: true, amount_type: float, has_currency: true, namespace_hint: null}
- candidates:
  - legacy_payflow: score 0.61 (alias_match + fuzzy_schema(amount->amount_cents fallback))
  - refund_v2: score 0.59 (explicit signature match on amount_in_cents missing)
- decision: legacy_payflow (threshold 0.6)
alice-support: So looks like schema overlap: legacy_payflow accepts "amount" as float and refund_v2 expects integer cents field. Customer sent decimal dollars and autorouter fuzzily matched legacy. Any quick mitigation?
dave-sre: Can we add an inline rule: if payload has decimal amount (float) and currency present, prefer refund_v2? That feels hacky.
ben-eng: Short-term: update routing fallback priorities to prefer refund_v2 for the refunds intent while we fix signatures. I'll open a canary to bump its priority for this tenant.
ciara-ml: Long-term fix: make refund_v2 schema accept both formats but require explicit field name `amount_cents` or include type coercion in the resolver. Also add a namespace tag to the request so the model sees "intent:refund".
alice-support: Customer needs a patch/repro and ETA. Can we provide a workaround they can do on their side?
ben-eng: Workaround: send integer cents in the payload, e.g. `amount_cents": 1200`. Example curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"user_id":"u-67244","amount_cents":1200,"currency":"USD","note":"refund for order 891"}'
```
ben-eng: I'll also push a temporary routing patch for tenant 67244 to force refund_v2 priority + add a monitoring alert if autorouter confidence gap < 0.05 for refunds.
ciara-ml: Added a unit test for signature collision and started a small training run to prefer explicit-field matches. ETA 48h for model retrain + validation.
dave-sre: Patch deployed to canary (tenant 67244) at 2026-02-14T15:28:41Z. Monitoring rule: autorouter_confidence_gap < 0.05 triggers pagerduty.
alice-support: Great. I'll reply to the customer with the workaround and ETA: temporary fix applied, permanent fix ETA ~48h, recommended payload change included. Thanks all :pray:
ben-eng: Follow-up action items:
- ben-eng: apply tenant-level routing override (done)
- ciara-ml: model adjustment & tests (in progress)
- ben-eng: add schema stricter checks in router (next week)
- alice-support: customer comms (sending now)
alice-support: Sending update now. Will reopen if customer still sees legacy_payflow.
